_comment: Knobs for the X AI Employee weekly worksnap pipeline. TODO values are blocked on Arjun — see PLAN.md 'Going live'. The pipeline auto-falls back to dry-run while TODOs/env keys are missing.

account._allowlist_note: Captions may name a client ONLY if the name is in this list. Arjun adds a name once it's verifiably public (named in our own past tweets, or on pixeluplabs.com case studies). Default for everything else: anonymous descriptors like 'a fintech client'.
account._note: Identity prose (bio, avatar, hard rules) lives in voice/persona.md — this block is the machine-readable mirror.

typefully._draft_mode_note: planned -> plan_at: inert drafts that NEVER auto-publish; Arjun confirms each in Typefully. Flipping to 'scheduled' -> publish_at makes drafts AUTO-PUBLISH at slot time with no human review. One word, big consequences.

figma._source_note: A separate Figma file, not the main working file. Designers copy cleared frames into it. Because the pipeline can only ever read this one file, a frame being present IS the clearance — NDA, finished-enough, and correct attribution all confirmed by whoever dragged it in.
figma._pick_note: Top-level frames in document order, FIFO, skipping node ids already in the journal. Nothing is ever written back to Figma; the PAT stays read-only.

posting._slots_note: IST times chosen for the US-founder ICP: 20:30 IST = 8:00am PT, 23:30 IST = 11:00am PT / 2:30pm ET. slot_labels name the slug suffix (2026-08-10-am), not the local time of day.
posting._start_note: First slot is tomorrow, never today — guarantees a review window in Typefully before anything is dated.
posting._buffer_note: prepare-week picks 14 + 4 candidates so Claude's QA pass can reject a few frames without shorting the week.

cta.text: Get a free brand perception audit.
cta._note: utm_content is set per-post to the date-slot slug (tweet id is unknown before publish). Query string MUST precede the #fragment or the UTMs land inside the fragment and analytics sees nothing — slots.mjs builds the URL so this cannot happen.

targets._signups_note: TBC with Daksh. Modelled range is ~40 over the quarter at 100k impressions.
